blocks.text: Introduction

The Internet of Things (IoT) and Mobile Virtual Network Operator ( MVNO ) sectors are experiencing unprecedented transformation in 2026. With advances in 5G connectivity, artificial intelligence integration, edge computing, and eSIM standardization, industry professionals need to stay informed about emerging trends and forge strategic partnerships to remain competitive in the connectivity market.

Whether you’re a technology executive, IoT engineer, MVNO operator, solution provider, or telecom decision-maker, the right conference can accelerate your digital transformation journey and open doors to high-value industry collaborations.
This comprehensive guide presents the must-attend IoT and MVNO conferences and events scheduled for 2026, organized chronologically to help you plan your year strategically.

blocks.text: January 2026
CES 2026 – Consumer Electronics Show Las Vegas
Dates: January 6-9, 2026 Location: Las Vegas, Nevada, USA Website: ces.tech

The Consumer Electronics Show (CES) remains a cornerstone event for IoT professionals and technology enthusiasts alike. Spanning innovations across IoT, wearables, and smart devices, CES offers a chance to witness cutting-edge technologies transforming industries. At the sprawling venue in Las Vegas, Nevada, attendees can explore exhibitions ranging from AI-driven IoT solutions to advancements in home automation. CES is also known for hosting thought-provoking keynote speeches by tech leaders, providing insights into future trends. Whether you’re into IoT solutions for business, healthcare, manufacturing, or smart homes, CES is an unparalleled opportunity to connect with innovators shaping the future of connectivity.
February 2026
IoT Tech Expo Global – London IoT Conference
Dates: February 4-5, 2026 Location: London, United Kingdom Website: iottechexpo.com/global

IoT Tech Expo Global stands as a leading international gathering for enterprise IoT adoption and digital transformation. Bringing together industry leaders from manufacturing, healthcare, and smart cities, the event showcases practical IoT implementations and connectivity strategies. At Olympia London, attendees can explore over 300 exhibitor showcases featuring 5G-enabled IoT deployments, digital twins for manufacturing, and IoT security frameworks. The conference is renowned for its expert-led keynotes and deep-dive sessions on topics ranging from intelligent automation to connected environments. Whether you’re an enterprise technology leader, IoT solution architect, or digital transformation officer, IoT Tech Expo Global provides invaluable insights into accelerating IoT adoption and building strategic partnerships.
AIoT World Expo 2026 – Artificial Intelligence IoT Conference
Dates: February 10-12, 2026 Location: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA Website: https://www.aiotworldexpo.com/east/

The AIoT World Expo emerges as the premier destination for exploring the convergence of artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things. Demonstrating how AI transforms connected systems and intelligent devices, the event serves technology leaders seeking real-world AIoT applications. At the Broward County Convention Center in Fort Lauderdale, participants witness live demonstrations of Edge AI applications, AI-powered cybersecurity for IoT networks, and predictive maintenance implementations. The expo is distinguished by its comprehensive exhibition of AI-enabled device management platforms and case studies from leading enterprises. Whether you’re an AI engineer, IoT developer, data scientist, or IT infrastructure manager, AIoT World Expo delivers actionable insights into harnessing artificial intelligence for connected device ecosystems.
March 2026
MWC Barcelona 2026 – Mobile World Congress
Dates: March 2-5, 2026 Location: Barcelona, Spain Website: mwcbarcelona.com

Mobile World Congress Barcelona represents the world’s most influential connectivity and mobile technology gathering. Uniting telecom executives, mobile network operators, and IoT professionals from across the globe, MWC showcases breakthrough innovations in 5G, eSIM standardization, and AI-driven networks. At the expansive Fira Gran Via venue, attendees experience a dedicated IoT Summit featuring real-world use case demonstrations, Open RAN architecture showcases, and satellite connectivity integrations. The event is celebrated for high-impact keynotes from industry visionaries and unparalleled networking opportunities with global stakeholders. Whether you’re a telecom executive, MVNO operator, connectivity solution provider, or policymaker, MWC Barcelona offers essential insights into the future of mobile connectivity and connected industries
Embedded World 2026 – Embedded Systems Conference Nuremberg
Dates: March 10-12, 2026 Location: Nuremberg, Germany Website: embedded-world.de/en

Embedded World stands as the premier global trade fair for embedded systems and IoT hardware innovation. Focusing on the intelligent devices powering modern connected systems, the event brings together developers, engineers, and system architects from automotive and industrial sectors. At NürnbergMesse in Nuremberg, participants explore comprehensive exhibitions of embedded IoT components, M2M communication protocols, and embedded vision systems. The conference is recognized for its high-quality technical program featuring hands-on workshops for IEC 61508 and ISO 26262 certifications, industrial metaverse applications, and digital twin integration techniques. Whether you’re an embedded systems engineer, IoT hardware developer, or product manager in safety-critical industries, embedded world provides deep technical knowledge and invaluable industry connections.
April 2026
FutureNet World 2026 – Network Automation Conference London
Dates: April 21-22, 2026 Location: London, United Kingdom Website: futurenetworld.net/events/futurenet-world-2026

FutureNet World positions itself as the definitive industry event for network automation and AI-driven telecom operations. Bringing together telecom executives, network operators, and technology vendors, the conference explores autonomous connectivity and Level 4 autonomous networks. At the InterContinental O2 near Canary Wharf, participants engage in executive roundtables, witness intent-based networking demonstrations, and discover industrial AI cloud platforms. The event is distinguished by its industry awards celebrating automation excellence and its focus on network slicing for enterprise and IoT applications. Whether you’re a network operations director, automation strategist, MVNO executive, or technology leader implementing AI transformation, FutureNet World delivers strategic insights into the next era of intelligent network operations.
MVNO NATION USA 2026 – Mobile Virtual Network Operator Conference
Dates: April 28-29, 2026 Location: Florida, USA Website: mvnonation.com/usa

MVNO NATION USA serves as the dedicated platform for mobile virtual network operators navigating the North American market. Addressing the unique challenges and opportunities facing MVNOs, the event unites executives, wholesale connectivity providers, and technology vendors. At the Florida venue, attendees participate in MVNO business model innovation sessions, eSIM implementation case studies, and digital-first customer acquisition workshops. The conference is notable for its practical focus on wholesale agreement negotiation tactics, IoT connectivity bundling strategies, and regulatory compliance updates specific to US MVNOs. Whether you’re an MVNO executive, mobile network operator, billing and OSS/BSS vendor, or entrepreneur entering the virtual network space, MVNO NATION USA provides essential knowledge for building successful MVNO operations.

Set clear objectives — be explicit about what you want to learn, discover, or achieve Prioritize what matters — focus on the most relevant sessions, speakers, and exhibits Network with purpose — build meaningful connections aligned to your goals Engage actively — participate in discussions, ask questions, and explore ideas deeply Convert insights into action — follow up and turn takeaways into concrete next steps
May 2026
IoT Tech Expo North America 2026 – San Jose IoT Conference
Dates: May 18-19, 2026 Location: San Jose, California, USA Website: iottechexpo.com/northamerica

IoT Tech Expo North America establishes itself as a comprehensive showcase for enterprise IoT and Industry 4.0 transformation. Featuring digital twins, connectivity solutions, and edge computing platforms, the event attracts technology leaders seeking practical implementation strategies. At the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, attendees explore interactive demonstrations of smart factory automation, IoT security frameworks, and 5G private network deployments. The conference is recognized for its co-located tracks spanning AI, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity, alongside process optimization success stories from Fortune 500 manufacturers. Whether you’re an IoT solution architect, manufacturing technology leader, data engineer, or security professional, IoT Tech Expo North America provides actionable guidance for accelerating digital transformation initiatives.
International Telecoms Week (ITW) – Wholesale Connectivity Conference
Dates: May 19-21, 2026 Location: National Harbor, Maryland, USA Website: internationaltelecomsweek.com/itw

International Telecoms Week remains the premier global event for wholesale connectivity deal-making and strategic collaboration. Facilitating partnerships across digital infrastructure and carrier services, ITW connects telecom leaders and connectivity investors worldwide. At the National Harbor venue in Maryland, participants engage in structured one-on-one meeting programs for wholesale agreements, executive keynotes on global connectivity trends, and MVNO-MNO partnership workshops. The event is valued for its IoT wholesale marketplace sessions, B2B enterprise connectivity panels, and updates on submarine cable and satellite infrastructure developments. Whether you’re a wholesale telecom executive, carrier services manager, MVNO business development leader, or connectivity investor, International Telecoms Week delivers unmatched opportunities for forging high-value telecommunications partnerships.
June 2026
MVNOs World Congress 2026 – Amsterdam MVNO Summit
Dates: June 1-3, 2026 Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands Website: mvnosworldcongress.com

MVNOs World Congress stands as the flagship global gathering for the mobile virtual network operator ecosystem. Addressing market trends, business innovation, and operational excellence, the event brings together MVNO executives, MNO partners, and technology vendors. At the Okura Hotel Amsterdam, participants dive into expert panels on MVNO profitability strategies, SGP.32 remote SIM provisioning workshops, and AI-powered customer experience implementations. The congress is renowned for its comprehensive coverage of IoT connectivity bundling for MVNOs, digital marketing strategies for subscriber acquisition, and regulatory compliance frameworks. Whether you’re an MVNO executive, MVNE technology vendor, telecom investor, or eSIM solution provider, MVNOs World Congress delivers critical insights for growing and future-proofing virtual network operations.
MWC Shanghai 2026 – Mobile World Congress Asia
Dates: June 24-26, 2026 Location: Shanghai, China Website: mwcshanghai.com

MWC Shanghai emerges as the leading connectivity event for the Asia-Pacific telecommunications landscape. Showcasing mobile innovation and digital transformation specific to regional markets, the conference attracts APAC operators and technology providers. At the Shanghai International Convention Center, attendees explore APAC-specific 5G deployment case studies, AI integration in Chinese mobile networks, and connected industries demonstrations from regional manufacturers. The event is distinguished by its focus on big data analytics implementations, regional regulatory environment insights, and China-specific smart city IoT projects. Whether you’re an APAC mobile operator, telecom executive, IoT solution provider, or professional targeting Asian markets, MWC Shanghai offers invaluable perspectives on regional connectivity trends and partnership opportunities.
July 2026
Blockchain and Internet of Things Conference (BIOTC 2026) – Tokyo
Dates: July 8-10, 2026 Location: Tokyo, Japan Website: biotc.net

The Blockchain and Internet of Things Conference represents a specialized academic and industry forum for distributed ledger technologies in connected systems. Advancing research at the intersection of blockchain and IoT, the event fosters collaboration between researchers, engineers, and practitioners. At the Tokyo venue, participants present peer-reviewed technical papers on blockchain-based device authentication, IoT data integrity implementations, and decentralized application architectures. The conference is valued for its rigorous academic standards, workshops on smart contract implementations for connected devices, and publication opportunities in indexed international proceedings. Whether you’re a researcher, blockchain engineer, IoT security specialist, or graduate student exploring distributed ledger applications, BIOTC provides a platform for knowledge exchange and collaborative innovation.
September 2026
The Things Conference 2026 – LoRaWAN IoT Event Amsterdam
Dates: September 22-23, 2026 Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands Website: thethingsconference.com

The Things Conference positions itself as the global hub for LoRaWAN and low-power IoT innovation. Focusing on real-world connected systems across diverse ecosystems, the event attracts developers and engineers deploying large-scale device networks. At De Kromhouthal in Amsterdam, attendees participate in hands-on LoRaWAN network architecture workshops, cellular IoT implementation sessions covering NB-IoT and LTE-M, and Edge AI demonstrations. The conference is celebrated for its hybrid connectivity strategy panels, Z-Wave integration tutorials, single-board computer development showcases, and practical IoT at scale deployment case studies. Whether you’re a LoRaWAN developer, low-power IoT engineer, edge computing specialist, or professional implementing enterprise-wide connected device deployments, The Things Conference delivers technical expertise and community connections.
October 2026
Futurecom 2026 – Latin America Telecom Conference
Dates: October 6-8, 2026 Location: São Paulo, Brazil Website: futurecom.com.br/en

Futurecom stands as Latin America’s premier technology and connectivity event driving regional telecom innovation. Addressing the unique challenges and opportunities of LATAM markets, the conference brings together operators, technology entrepreneurs, and connectivity providers. At the São Paulo convention center, attendees access LATAM-specific regulatory environment updates, MVNO opportunities in emerging Latin American markets, and regional IoT deployment strategies. The event is recognized for its wireless services innovation panels, Brazilian and regional smart city initiatives, network infrastructure modernization roadmaps, and cybersecurity challenges specific to Latin American telecommunications. Whether you’re a LATAM telecom operator, MVNO executive targeting Latin American markets, connectivity provider, or regional technology entrepreneur, Futurecom delivers critical insights for navigating and succeeding in Latin America’s dynamic telecommunications landscape.
IoT Tech Expo Europe 2026 – Amsterdam IoT Conference
Dates: October 20-21, 2026 Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands Website: iottechexpo.com/europe

IoT Tech Expo Europe establishes itself as the definitive conference for enterprise IoT innovation within European market contexts. Emphasizing regulatory compliance and regional strategies, the event serves technology leaders navigating EU requirements and Industry 4.0 initiatives. At the Amsterdam venue, participants attend EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) compliance workshops, EU AI Act implementation guidance sessions, and manufacturing IoT demonstrations. The conference is distinguished by its European smart cities project showcases, supply chain optimization case studies, digital twin technology exhibitions, and co-located tracks covering cybersecurity and edge computing. Whether you’re a European technology leader, IoT compliance officer, Industry 4.0 strategist, or supply chain digitalization manager, IoT Tech Expo Europe provides essential knowledge for succeeding in the European IoT landscape.
Why Attend IoT and MVNO Conferences in 2026

Attending IoT and MVNO conferences in 2026 can help connectivity professionals stay ahead of fast-evolving industry trends while gaining early access to technologies shaping the future of telecom. These events offer real-world insights into emerging solutions, regulatory developments, and proven use cases that directly inform business and technology strategy. They also create high-value, face-to-face networking opportunities within the global connectivity ecosystem.

blocks.text: 2025 is shaping up to be a pivotal year for IoT professionals, with a lineup of global events showcasing advancements in connectivity, AI, cybersecurity in IoT , and smart technologies. From CES in Las Vegas, highlighting cutting-edge wearables and enterprise IoT, to IoT Tech Expo in London and Barcelona’s IoT Solutions World Congress, these events provide unparalleled opportunities for learning, networking, and collaboration. Professionals can explore emerging trends, innovative IoT solutions for business , and market strategies while connecting with industry leaders. With Spenza at the forefront of IoT expense and connectivity management, these events also offer the perfect backdrop for discovering tools to enhance IoT efficiency and scalability.

The IoT industry continues to grow at an exponential rate, impacting everything from smart cities to enterprise connectivity. Keeping up with trends, innovations, and industry leaders is vital for professionals eager to stay ahead. Events are a key part of this, offering opportunities to network, learn, and explore groundbreaking ideas, especially in areas like cybersecurity in IoT and IoT solutions for business.

For IoT professionals, 2025 is brimming with opportunities to dive deeper into the world of the Internet of Things, connectivity, and advanced technology. Attending key industry conferences keeps you updated and helps build connections that drive innovation and business success.
Below is a detailed look at the major events you should consider, followed by actionable tips to maximize your conference experience.
January: CES
Dates : January 7-10, 2025 Location : Las Vegas, Nevada, USA Venue : Las Vegas Convention Center Link : CES 2025 Official Website

The Consumer Electronics Show (CES) remains a cornerstone event for IoT professionals and enthusiasts alike. Spanning innovations across IoT, wearables, and smart devices, CES offers a chance to witness cutting-edge technologies transforming industries. At the sprawling venue in Las Vegas, Nevada, attendees can explore exhibitions ranging from AI-driven IoT solutions to advancements in home automation. CES is also known for hosting thought-provoking keynote speeches by tech leaders, providing insights into future trends. Whether you’re into IoT solutions for business, healthcare, manufacturing, or smart homes, CES is an unparalleled opportunity to connect with innovators shaping the future of connectivity.
February: IoT Tech Expo Global
Dates : February 5-6, 2025 Location : London, UK Venue : Olympia, Hammersmith Road, London Link : IoT Tech Expo Global

Held at the iconic Olympia in London , the IoT Tech Expo Global focuses on diverse IoT applications across industries like healthcare, energy, and transportation. This two-day event emphasizes the intersection of IoT with technologies like edge computing, AI, blockchain, and cybersecurity in IoT. Attendees can gain in-depth knowledge through expert-led panel discussions and workshops while exploring the latest products in the exhibitor hall. Networking opportunities are abundant, with dedicated sessions for forging connections with thought leaders, entrepreneurs, and tech experts.
IoT Evolution Expo
Dates : February 11-13, 2025 Location : Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA Venue : Greater Fort Lauderdale/Broward County Convention Center Link : IoT Evolution Expo

Taking place in Fort Lauderdale, Florida , the IoT Evolution Expo focuses on actionable business use cases for IoT. Topics like logistics optimization, connected infrastructure, IoT solutions for business, and IoT-driven analytics take center stage. This event is ideal for professionals seeking practical solutions to IoT challenges. The dynamic expo hall offers a platform for exploring new technologies and engaging with solution providers.
March: MWC Barcelona
Dates : March 3-6, 2025 Location : Barcelona, Spain Venue : Fira Gran Via Link : MWC Barcelona

Known as the epicenter of connectivity, MWC Barcelona is where IoT and telecom giants converge. Hosted at Fira Gran Via , this global event showcases advancements in 5G, IoT billing, cybersecurity in IoT, and next-gen cellular solutions. Attendees can explore hands-on demos, attend partner announcements, and dive into sessions exploring topics such as private cellular networks and the future of IoT in smart cities. The Channel Partners Conference is designed for IoT and telecom professionals exploring partnerships to enhance connectivity solutions. Hosted at the luxurious Venetian in Las Vegas, this event brings together tech innovators, service providers, and decision-makers to explore collaborative opportunities. The exhibition hall features vendors offering solutions tailored to IoT, connectivity, cybersecurity in IoT, and telecom, making it a great platform to explore new tools for scaling operations.

Dates : April 23-24, 2025 Location : London, UK Venue : Business Design Centre, London Link : Hardware Pioneers

Hardware Pioneers is a must-attend for professionals in IoT device development. Hosted at the Business Design Centre in London, this two-day event offers an immersive experience with workshops, live demos, and product launches. Panels explore topics like hardware security, cybersecurity in IoT, IoT sensor technologies, and the role of AI in device optimization. This hands-on event encourages attendees to engage with prototypes and connect directly with hardware innovators, fostering practical learning and innovation in IoT device design.

Connectivity Expo focuses on advancements in IoT networks, 5G, and smart city infrastructure. Taking place at Chicago’s McCormick Place, this event caters to IoT professionals interested in scaling IoT applications through robust connectivity. Key topics include private LTE, rural broadband solutions, and IoT-enabling infrastructures, with discussions highlighting cybersecurity in IoT. The expo combines knowledge-sharing with interactive sessions, providing practical insights into connectivity innovations shaping the IoT landscape for businesses.

The event also explores the integration of AI with sensor systems, ensuring attendees leave with actionable insights into the future of IoT.
Making the Most of an IoT Conference
Conferences can be overwhelming, but with a strategic approach, you can maximize your ROI. Here’s how:

Set Specific Learning Goals: Pinpoint key areas to explore, such as IoT monetization, cybersecurity in IoT, or eSIM connectivity. This will help you select the right sessions and focus your networking. Use Conference Apps Efficiently: Many events have dedicated apps for schedules, exhibitor maps, and networking. Leverage these tools to plan your day and connect with attendees exploring IoT solutions for business. Engage in Targeted Networking: Prioritize quality over quantity in your conversations. Seek out professionals in IoT monetization, private networks, or data management, aligning with your objectives. Dive Into Interactive Sessions: Attend workshops, panels, or Q&As. They often provide actionable insights into topics like cybersecurity in IoT and allow you to engage directly with industry experts. Follow Up Quickly: Don’t let the energy of a great conversation fade. Follow up with your new contacts soon after the event to solidify your connection.
